name: @petepetrash/circuit
description: Workflow engine that runs structured developer flows from a plain CLI, with per-step configurability, evidence, checks, traces, and reports. Claude Code and Codex plugins are the bridge that teaches a host agent to drive it.

scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config tests/browser/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check-yaml-schemas: npm run build && npm run check-yaml-schemas:nobuild
scripts.soak:runtime:fast: vitest run tests/soak tests/runner/cli-runtime.test.ts tests/runtime tests/flow-runtime-smoke
scripts.soak:runtime: vitest run tests/soak && npm run verify && npm run check-flow-drift:nobuild
scripts.emit-flows: npm run build-checkpoint-review-runtime && npm run build && node scripts/flows/emit.ts && npm run build-plugin-runtime
scripts.check-flow-drift: npm run build && npm run check-flow-drift:nobuild
scripts.check-flow-drift:nobuild: node scripts/flows/emit.ts --check && npm run check-checkpoint-review-runtime && npm run check-plugin-runtime
scripts.emit-release: npm run build && node scripts/release/emit-current-capabilities.ts && node scripts/release/render-parity-matrix.ts && node scripts/release/render-readiness-report.ts
scripts.check-release-infra: npm run build && npm run check-release-infra:nobuild
scripts.check-release-infra:nobuild: node scripts/release/emit-current-capabilities.ts --check && node scripts/release/check-parity.ts && node scripts/release/check-public-claims.ts && node scripts/release/check-proof-coverage.ts && node scripts/release/check-codex-mcp-first-run-proof.ts && node scripts/release/check-codex-mcp-candidate-matrix.ts && npm run check-proof-stubs:nobuild && node scripts/release/render-parity-matrix.ts --check && node scripts/release/render-readiness-report.ts --check && node scripts/release/audit-public-docs.ts && node scripts/release/audit-marketplace-safe-paths.ts && node scripts/release/check-npm-package-install.ts && npm run check-codex-mcp-package
scripts.sync:host-plugin-caches: npm run sync:claude-plugin-cache && npm run sync:codex-plugin-cache
scripts.check:host-plugin-caches: npm run check:claude-plugin-cache && npm run check:codex-plugin-cache
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run check-evals && npm run check-ideas && npm run check-doc-paths && npm run check-yaml-schemas:nobuild && npm run check-flow-drift:nobuild && npm run check-release-infra:nobuild
scripts.verify:fast: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:fast && npm run check-evals && npm run check-ideas && npm run check-doc-paths && npm run check-yaml-schemas:nobuild && npm run check-flow-drift:nobuild
